description:
Canvas by Lattices is a read-only companion to Canvas for Mac. Browse your Mac's notes and workspaces on iPhone and iPad, then keep reading offline.

Connect to a Mac running Canvas on the same local network and approve your device on the Mac. Your notes transfer in an encrypted snapshot. The original Markdown files stay on your Mac; this app stores a local copy for reading.

• Browse notes by workspace
• Search downloaded notes, even offline
• Read notes in layouts for iPhone and iPad
• Explore sample notes without a Mac or an account

This first release is a viewer for Canvas notes. Create and edit your notes on the Mac. To sync your own notes, you need Canvas for Mac and local-network access. No account or cloud service is required.

Remove the downloaded copy in Settings → On This Device → Notes → Remove Notes. Your Mac's original notes stay in place.
promotionalText: Your Canvas notes from Mac, ready to read on iPhone and iPad. Browse workspaces, search offline, or explore sample notes before connecting your Mac.
